dossier.scp_unleashed.129.title: Fivefold Spore
dossier.scp_unleashed.129.caption: Cultures of all five strains of SCP-129, laid out for comparison.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: The five primary cultures of SCP-129 are held in sealed vials inside a powered cold locker. Sealed glass is a complete barrier. **A gas mask is sufficient protection** against every strain. No suit is required, and none is issued.

Personnel in contact with affected staff are to be swabbed, and the swab read in an analyzer, before they rejoin other personnel. Affected staff are kept apart from one another until their readings have been compared. Any reading that shows SCP-129-4 is to be reported to the duty researcher at once.
A counter-agent prepared from the cultures themselves is kept beside the locker. %rPreparation is set out in Procedure 129-Verdant.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-129 is a fungus that exists as five distinct strains, numbered SCP-129-1 to SCP-129-5, each a different shade of green. It grows on nothing outside a culture dish. It lives in people.

Spores reach anyone with a clear line to an open culture, and they pass from any affected person to the people around them: across a room, in a cough, at arm's length or by touch. A gas mask stops them in both directions.

Each strain shows itself differently. Carriers of SCP-129-1 fall into fits of coughing. SCP-129-2 blurs the sight for a few seconds at a time. SCP-129-3 stops its carriers dead: for a few seconds they can neither see nor walk, and every turn of the head comes slow and heavy. All three pass on their own. SCP-129-4 on its own causes a mild cough and nothing more. SCP-129-5 causes nothing at all, and it does not pass.
**Two of the strains are not harmless together.** %rNeither is a strain staff worry about.%r Affected staff who are not treated within minutes do not recover.

page.title: Addendum 129-1: Field Note
text: A researcher cleared of a mild cough was returned to duty the same week. She was still carrying SCP-129-5, and nobody had swabbed for it, because nobody had ever seen it do anything.
%rShe did not finish her next shift.%r

page.title: Addendum 129-2: Provenance
text: SCP-129 was not recovered. Five vials were handed to a reader of this file by an individual in Foundation dress, the same individual described in the files of other objects.
Asked which of the five was the dangerous one, the individual said that depended on the company it kept. See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp129_suppressant.to: A single-dose spore suppressant in a sprung injector.
item.scp_unleashed.scp129_suppressant.ot: Use on another person to inject them
item.scp_unleashed.scp129_suppressant.cl: Clears every strain of SCP-129 and briefly keeps new spores from taking hold
item.scp_unleashed.scp129_suppressant.si: One dose. It does nothing for any other anomaly.
message.scp_unleashed.scp129.treated: The suppressant burns cold as it goes in.
message.scp_unleashed.scp129.stage.3: Green specks swim at the edge of your sight.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp129_suppressan: A single-dose suppressant for SCP-129, prepared from a culture of any one of its strains. The culture's vial comes back empty.
Use it to inject yourself, or use it on another player, a D-Class or a villager. It clears every strain at once, at any stage.
For a short while afterwards new spores fail to take hold. It does nothing for any other anomaly.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp129.0: Five sealed green samples are on their way to you. Keep them sealed.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp129.1: The contact finds the reader. Wait somewhere out in the open.
